subject.title: fix(config): bound state-directory .env file reads with size limit

question: Should an existing state-directory `.env` above 1 MiB be silently ignored, or should the new bounded-read policy provide a visible diagnostic and an explicitly approved compatibility contract?
rationale: The security hardening is plausible, but the selected failure behavior changes startup configuration semantics for existing users and can make credentials or settings disappear without a direct cause.

options.title: Warn and keep the bound
options.body: Retain the 1 MiB bounded reader, emit a targeted diagnostic when the file exceeds the limit, and add focused coverage for that operator-visible outcome.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility contract
options.body: Approve a different limit or failure behavior if state-directory `.env` files are intended to support larger stored values.

options.title: Pause this narrow patch
options.body: Defer the change until the state-directory configuration contract and its upgrade behavior are decided together.

recommendation.title: Warn and keep the bound
recommendation.body: Retain the 1 MiB bounded reader, emit a targeted diagnostic when the file exceeds the limit, and add focused coverage for that operator-visible outcome.
